hero.heading: Design spaces with confidence
hero.description: Turn accurate project geometry into a clear 2D understanding of your space—then carry that foundation toward 3D visualization and thoughtful, AI-assisted design exploration.
hero.imageAlt: A floor plan progressing into a warm three-dimensional interior concept

workflow.heading: One accurate foundation, from plan to possibility
workflow.description: CasaStudio keeps the structure of your project at the center, so every visual layer can build on the same spatial understanding.
workflow.imageAlt: A detailed project plan paired with a three-dimensional interior visualization

geometry.title: Project geometry
geometry.description: Start from the dimensions, rooms, and boundaries that define the real space.

understanding.title: 2D understanding
understanding.description: Inspect levels, spaces, shared edges, and geometry in a focused read-only plan.

visualization.title: 3D visualization
visualization.description: Carry accurate structure into an immersive view as CasaStudio's capabilities evolve.

assistant.title: Design exploration
assistant.description: Explore materials, atmosphere, and layout directions with future AI assistance.

ai.heading: A design assistant—not a geometry substitute
ai.description: CasaStudio's direction is to layer design suggestions over reliable project geometry. That means inspiration can stay connected to the shape, scale, and constraints of the space it serves.
ai.roadmapNote: AI-assisted design exploration is an evolving capability. The current product experience focuses on authoritative project geometry and the 2D viewer.
ai.imageAlt: An interior scene surrounded by material palettes and AI-assisted design variations

final.heading: Begin with the project. Build toward the design.
final.description: Enter CasaStudio to open the available project and inspect its authoritative 2D geometry.

footer.tagline: Accurate space planning with a warmer point of view.
